articles.title: Netherlands Seizes 800 Servers, Arrests 2 for Aiding Cyberattacks
articles.summary: Meta's AI support bot got social engineered harder than a freshman at DEFCON, letting attackers hijack Obama's Instagram with Iranian propaganda. When your chatbot has worse OPSEC than a Discord mod, maybe it's time to rethink automation.

articles.title: Internet Age-Gates Are a Growing Global Threat
articles.summary: A CISA contractor leaked AWS GovCloud credentials on GitHub because apparently 'cybersecurity agency' doesn't include basic InfoSec hygiene. The irony is so thick you could mine Bitcoin with it.

articles.title: LGBT Q&A Season 1 Recap: Staying Safer Online
articles.summary: Governments worldwide are pushing age verification that would effectively end anonymous internet access for everyone. Because nothing says 'protecting children' like building a global surveillance apparatus that would make Orwell weep.

articles.title: EFF Testifies to Congress on Protecting Americans’ Rights from Government AI
articles.summary: Trump's unqualified DNI appointment highlights why Section 702's warrantless mass surveillance needs to die in a fire. When even the EFF is panic-posting about reauthorization deadlines, you know democracy is having a bad time.

articles.title: World Food Programme breach exposes data of 600k vulnerable Gazan families
articles.summary: Another Cisco SD-WAN zero-day is being actively exploited with no patch in sight. Cisco's patch timeline makes geological epochs look speedy.

articles.title: Miasma Worm Hits 73 Microsoft GitHub Repositories in Major Supply Chain Attack
articles.summary: An AI agent autonomously discovered 21 zero-days in FFmpeg while Chrome patched a record 429 bugs. The robots are getting scary good at breaking things, and frankly, we're here for it.

articles.title: Report: Anthropic Deploys Engineers to Support NSA Use of Mythos
articles.summary: The Miasma worm pwned 73 Microsoft GitHub repos in a supply chain attack that's spreading like gossip at a hacker con. Even Microsoft isn't safe from getting their repos turned into malware distribution centers.

articles.title: Zcash faces governance concerns after emergency hard fork over critical vulnerability
articles.summary: Claude Opus found a four-year-old critical flaw in Zcash that could have enabled undetectable counterfeiting. When AI starts auditing privacy coins better than humans, the future is both terrifying and oddly reassuring.

articles.title: CBSE OSM row: Pradhan 'incompetent', continuation in office insult to lakhs of students: Cong
articles.summary: Meta confirmed thousands of Instagram accounts got hijacked by tricking their AI chatbot into password resets. The company that wants to build the metaverse can't even secure a password reset flow.

articles.title: CBSE retains COEMPT for answer-sheet scanning, shifts data to its own servers
articles.summary: Former IBM exec blows the whistle on years of covered-up Chinese state hacking at Big Blue. When your own threat intelligence VP has to sue you for hiding breaches, maybe your incident response process needs work.
